p.src: 1  Where has your beloved gone, you fairest among women? Where has your beloved turned, that we may seek him with you?

ja: ったのか。 あなたの
en: Where has your beloved gone, you fairest among women? Where has your beloved turned, that we may seek him with you?
u.src: 1  Where has your beloved gone, you fairest among women? Where has your beloved turned, that we may seek him with you?

p.src: 2  My beloved has gone down to his garden, to the beds of spices, to pasture his flock in the gardens, and to gather lilies.

ja: の庭へ、 香料の花壇へ
い、ゆりを集めるために。
en: My beloved has gone down to his garden, to the beds of spices, to pasture his flock in the gardens, and to gather lilies.
u.src: 2  My beloved has gone down to his garden, to the beds of spices, to pasture his flock in the gardens, and to gather lilies.

p.src: 3  I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine. He browses among the lilies.

ja: のもの。 あの人はゆりの間で
en: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine. He browses among the lilies.
u.src: 3  I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine. He browses among the lilies.

p.src: 4  You are beautiful, my love, as Tirzah, lovely as Jerusalem, awesome as an army with banners.

ja: する女よ、あなたはティルツァのように
しく、 エルサレムのように
のように畏れを抱かせる。
en: You are beautiful, my love, as Tirzah, lovely as Jerusalem, awesome as an army with banners.
u.src: 4  You are beautiful, my love, as Tirzah, lovely as Jerusalem, awesome as an army with banners.

p.src: 5  Turn away your eyes from me, for they have overcome me. Your hair is like a flock of goats, that lie along the side of Gilead.

ja: からそらしておくれ。 その
れのよう、 ギレアデの山腹に伏す群れのようだ。
en: Turn away your eyes from me, for they have overcome me. Your hair is like a flock of goats, that lie along the side of Gilead.
u.src: 5  Turn away your eyes from me, for they have overcome me. Your hair is like a flock of goats, that lie along the side of Gilead.

p.src: 6  Your teeth are like a flock of ewes, which have come up from the washing, of which every one has twins; not one is bereaved among them.

ja: れのようだ。 どれも
en: Your teeth are like a flock of ewes, which have come up from the washing, of which every one has twins; not one is bereaved among them.
u.src: 6  Your teeth are like a flock of ewes, which have come up from the washing, of which every one has twins; not one is bereaved among them.

p.src: 7  Your temples are like a piece of a pomegranate behind your veil.

ja: ベールの後ろのあなたのこめかみは、ざくろの一
en: Your temples are like a piece of a pomegranate behind your veil.
u.src: 7  Your temples are like a piece of a pomegranate behind your veil.

p.src: 8  There are sixty queens, eighty concubines, and virgins without number.

en: There are sixty queens, eighty concubines, and virgins without number.
u.src: 8  There are sixty queens, eighty concubines, and virgins without number.

p.src: 9  My dove, my perfect one, is unique. She is her mother’s only daughter. She is the favorite one of her who bore her. The daughters saw her, and called her blessed. The queens and the concubines saw her, and they praised her.

en: My dove, my perfect one, is unique. She is her mother’s only daughter. She is the favorite one of her who bore her. The daughters saw her, and called her blessed. The queens and the concubines saw her, and they praised her.
u.src: 9  My dove, my perfect one, is unique. She is her mother’s only daughter. She is the favorite one of her who bore her. The daughters saw her, and called her blessed. The queens and the concubines saw her, and they praised her.

p.src: 10  Who is she who looks out as the morning, beautiful as the moon, clear as the sun, and awesome as an army with banners?

ja: のように畏れを抱かせるこの人は誰か。
en: Who is she who looks out as the morning, beautiful as the moon, clear as the sun, and awesome as an army with banners?
u.src: 10  Who is she who looks out as the morning, beautiful as the moon, clear as the sun, and awesome as an army with banners?

p.src: 11  I went down into the nut tree grove, to see the green plants of the valley, to see whether the vine budded, and the pomegranates were in flower.

ja: 私は谷間の若葉を見ようと、 くるみの木の林へ
en: I went down into the nut tree grove, to see the green plants of the valley, to see whether the vine budded, and the pomegranates were in flower.
u.src: 11  I went down into the nut tree grove, to see the green plants of the valley, to see whether the vine budded, and the pomegranates were in flower.

p.src: 12  Without realizing it, my desire set me with my royal people’s chariots.

ja: 気づかぬうちに、 私の願いは私を、王家の
en: Without realizing it, my desire set me with my royal people’s chariots.
u.src: 12  Without realizing it, my desire set me with my royal people’s chariots.

p.src: 13  Return, return, Shulammite! Return, return, that we may gaze at you. Lover Why do you desire to gaze at the Shulammite, as at the dance of Mahanaim?

ja: 戻って来てください。戻って来てください、シュラムの
よ。 戻って来てください。戻って来てください。あなたを
つめたいのです。 愛する男 なぜあなたがたは、マハナイムの踊りでも見るように、 シュラムの
en: Return, return, Shulammite! Return, return, that we may gaze at you. Lover Why do you desire to gaze at the Shulammite, as at the dance of Mahanaim?
u.src: 13  Return, return, Shulammite! Return, return, that we may gaze at you. Lover Why do you desire to gaze at the Shulammite, as at the dance of Mahanaim?
